newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau gangsters beat Chinese enovy, driver - police.
newsitem.headline: Macau gangsters beat Chinese enovy, driver - police.

text.p: Macau police said on Saturday they had arrested two men after a Chinese envoy and his driver were attacked with iron bars in the Portuguese-administered colony.

The second secretary of China's delegation of the Sino-Portuguese Joint Liaison Group -- which will oversee Portugal's handover of Macau to Chinese rule in 1999 -- and his driver were beaten on Friday morning, Macau officials said.
The two men, who were attacked in front of a building housing mainland Chinese officials posted to Macau, were recovering in hospital on Saturday in satisfactory condition, police said.
The alleged suspects fled in their car, which had blocked the second secretary's official car, a Chinese statement released in Macau said on Friday.
A police source said the attackers were likely low-ranking gangsters connected to local organised crime syndicates known as triads.
